response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each manager_award row counts as one award win; NULL throws values form the missing group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct award-winning managers rather than award wins.
alternatives.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;
